svg.title: GL-136 tank monitor wiring - single supply, corrected current loop
svg.desc: Final corrected wiring: 12V+ to SEN0262 green +, sensor red to SEN0262 green -, 12V- direct to sensor black. LM2596 taps 12V for ESP32 power. SEN0262 signal output to ESP32 via jumper wires.

g.text: VCC from ESP32 3V3 sets output range
